name: bloodsoaked_altar_demon_is_black
notes: Printed: 'a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying'. The opponent activates the Altar on their own turn (their Yoked Ox is sacrificed, their Forest discarded): a flying Demon token. On the controller's turn Apostle of Purifying Light (protection from black: it can't be blocked by black creatures, CR 702.16f) attacks. The token is a flier and untapped, so it could block any other attacker, but not this one: it is never asked to block (not_asked_to_block names the token by its handle) and no block is declared. (The same pack with a non-protected attacker, Leafkin Druid, has the token block it.)
